items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero section with an announcement badge, headline, subtitle, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Place it as the first section of your landing page to immediately communicate your product value and drive sign-ups.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered hero section with a grid background, headline, CTA buttons, and a featured product screenshot. Use it above the fold on app or SaaS landing pages to visually showcase your product and guide visitors toward action.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero with star rating social proof, key statistics card, and call-to-action buttons. Use it when you need to build immediate trust and highlight traction metrics on SaaS or agency landing pages.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Minimal full-screen centered hero with headline, subtitle, and CTA buttons on a clean background. Use it as a distraction-free entry point for products that rely on strong copy rather than visuals.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column feature grid displaying product benefits as icon cards with titles and descriptions. Use it to quickly communicate your product's key capabilities anywhere on a SaaS or marketing landing page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column image grid showcasing product features with visual screenshots and short descriptions. Use it to let your interface speak for itself while giving context for each feature shown.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column icon card grid for listing product features with icons, titles, and short descriptions. Use it as a lightweight, fast-loading feature showcase section that stays scannable on any screen size.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive accordion feature section where clicking each item reveals a corresponding product screenshot. Use it to keep the section compact while letting users explore features at their own pace.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing table with a monthly/yearly billing toggle, a highlighted recommended plan, and feature lists. Use it on dedicated pricing pages to help users choose the right plan and increase conversion.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Side-by-side pricing comparison table with feature rows and checkmark/cross indicators. Use it when your plans share many features and you want to make the differences crystal clear for potential buyers.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a tabbed billing toggle, feature lists with separators, and CTA buttons. Use it as an alternative pricing layout when you want to visually emphasize the most popular plan.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a highlighted popular plan featuring a dark gradient background, monthly/yearly billing toggle with a green indicator, and custom price display. Use it for SaaS products that want to visually differentiate the recommended plan.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-stripe-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Connected pricing section that fetches products and prices live from the Stripe API and renders them as cards. Each card shows the plan name, description, amount, and a checkout button that creates a Stripe Checkout session.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal call-to-action section with a heading, description, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Use it at the end of landing page sections to nudge visitors toward sign-up or purchase at the right moment.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] CTA card with an app or device mockup image, headline, and action button. Use it to close a landing page with a visually driven conversion prompt that showcases your product in context.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Newsletter subscription CTA with an email input and a submit button. Use it to capture leads directly within your content by embedding a low-friction email signup anywhere on the page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered CTA card with a subtle grid background, bold headline, description, and action button. Use it as a section-closing block that re-engages visitors who scrolled past earlier conversion points.

items.name: arnaudvolp/faq-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Single-column accordion FAQ section with expandable question and answer items. Use it on landing pages, pricing pages, or support sections to address common objections and reduce incoming support requests.

items.name: arnaudvolp/faq-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column accordion FAQ grid for displaying a larger set of questions side by side. Use it when you have ten or more questions and want to keep the FAQ section compact and well-organized.

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Scrolling testimonial section with two animated marquee rows of customer review cards. Use it as a social proof belt on landing pages to continuously surface customer validation without requiring any user interaction.

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Masonry grid wall-of-love section displaying multiple customer reviews in a varied layout. Use it on marketing sites where you have rich social proof and want to display it in a visually engaging way.

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Stats section displaying key product or business metrics in individual icon cards with labels. Use it to quantify your impact on landing pages and give visitors concrete, trust-building numbers.

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal stats section with large numbers and labels separated by dividers. Use it as a compact, eye-catching metrics strip that fits naturally between any two sections on a landing page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/logo-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Logo cloud section with two infinite scrolling marquee rows showcasing partner or customer logos. Use it immediately after your hero section to build trust through brand association with recognized names.

items.name: arnaudvolp/contact-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Contact section with a card-wrapped form (name, email, message) alongside company contact information. Use it on contact or about pages to give visitors a direct, professional way to reach your team.

items.name: arnaudvolp/footer-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Multi-column footer with company branding, grouped navigation links, and social media icons. Use it on every page of your site to provide consistent navigation, important links, and legal information at the bottom.

items.name: arnaudvolp/navbar-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Responsive navbar with dropdown navigation menus on desktop and an accordion-based mobile menu. Use it as your site-wide header to provide clear, accessible navigation across all screen sizes and devices.

items.name: arnaudvolp/team-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Team section displaying members in cards with profile photos, names, job roles, and social links. Use it on about pages to humanize your brand and help visitors connect with the people behind your product.

items.name: arnaudvolp/social-icons
items.description: [Shadcnship] Collection of SVG social media brand icons (GitHub, Google, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and more) as composable React components. Use them in login forms, footers, navbars, or any UI that references external social platforms.

items.name: arnaudvolp/login-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Split-screen login page with a gradient background on one side and an email/password form with OAuth buttons on the other. Use it as a drop-in authentication page when you need a polished login experience fast.

items.name: arnaudvolp/blog-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Blog section with post cards featuring cover images, category badges, titles, excerpts, and author info. Use it on content sites or product blogs to display articles in a clean, scannable grid layout.

items.name: arnaudvolp/register-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered registration card with full name, email, and password fields, including client-side validation. Use it as a clean sign-up page for any web application that requires user account creation.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable square grid background component with adjustable line color, grid size, and opacity props. Use it as a decorative backdrop for hero sections, cards, or any area that benefits from a subtle geometric texture.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable dot pattern background with adjustable dot color, size, spacing, and opacity. Use it behind hero sections or feature areas to add visual depth without distracting from your main content.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable diagonal stripes background with adjustable line color, width, spacing, and opacity. Use it to add a subtle textile-like pattern to sections, cards, or full-page backgrounds.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable vertical lines background with adjustable line count, width, color, and opacity. Use it behind hero or pricing sections to create a structured, architectural visual backdrop.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive grid background where individual cells highlight on hover with a configurable glow color. Use it behind hero sections or interactive showcases to add a playful, dynamic feel to an otherwise static layout.

items.name: arnaudvolp/changelog-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Timeline-style changelog listing product updates with version numbers, release dates, and descriptions. Use it on product or documentation sites to communicate release history and build trust with power users.

items.name: arnaudvolp/integration-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Dark-themed integration showcase with a curved connection path drawn between tool logos. Use it on landing pages to visually communicate how your product fits into your users' existing toolchain.

items.name: arnaudvolp/banner-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width announcement banner with a short message, an arrow link, and a dismiss button. Use it at the top of any page to surface time-sensitive promotions, feature launches, or important product updates.

items.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist signup section with an email capture form and social proof avatars showing subscriber count. Use it on coming-soon pages to build an audience before your product launches and validate demand early.

items.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist section with a Supabase-connected email form that stores submissions directly to your database. Use it when your backend is Supabase and you want a zero-config waitlist with persistent storage out of the box.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] Four-step process section with numbered badges, step titles, descriptions, and an optional screenshot. Use it to explain how your product works, step by step, on landing and onboarding pages.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-07
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width video player section with a poster image and an animated play button overlay. Use it on landing pages to embed a product demo or explainer video where showing beats telling.

items.name: arnaudvolp/comparison-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Product comparison table with images, specification rows, and checkmark/cross value indicators. Use it on product or pricing pages to help users make confident purchase decisions by clearly highlighting key differences.

items.name: arnaudvolp/dashboard-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Sales analytics dashboard with revenue KPI cards, interactive bar charts, and a recent orders table. Use it as a starting point for admin panels, analytics views, or any SaaS backend interface.

items.name: arnaudvolp/logo-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Client logo grid with clickable industry and technology category filters and featured logo cards. Use it on portfolio or case study pages to showcase logos while allowing visitors to filter by what matters to them.

items.name: arnaudvolp/login-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-stack split-screen auth page with Supabase email/password login and OAuth provider support. Use it as a complete, ready-to-ship login page when your backend is powered by Supabase Auth.

items.name: arnaudvolp/data-table-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Paginated data table with global search and sortable columns. Two modes: pass a data array for client-side rendering, or a Supabase table name for server-side pagination. Supports text, date, badge, tags, and status cell types.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-09
items.description: [Shadcnship] An integrations grid with icon cards in a 3x2 layout and social proof ratings

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-08
items.description: [Shadcnship] A bento-style feature grid with a large featured card and icon-based feature cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered hero with multi-image cards below at varying heights

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] A bento-grid stats section mixing images and metric cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/navbar-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] A responsive navbar with mega menu, grouped columns, featured panel, and mobile accordion

items.name: arnaudvolp/cookie-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] A floating cookie consent card with accept button and learn more link

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-11
items.description: [Shadcnship] A feature section with a split left-aligned header and two large image cards with text below

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] A two-column testimonial carousel with prev/next navigation and portrait image cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-12
items.description: [Shadcnship] A feature section with a large clickable title list on the left and an image with description on the right that updates on selection

items.name: arnaudvolp/image-compare
items.description: [Shadcnship] A before/after image slider — drag the divider to compare both sides in real time

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] A full-screen centered hero with background image, announcement badge, and CTA buttons

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered CTA with a fanned stack of rotated photos, badge, contrast title, and pill button

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A stats section with minimal navbar, large headline, and icons orbiting a center avatar

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] A split stats section with badge, title, CTA link, and avatars on the left and an asymmetric grid of metric cards on the right

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] A stats section in a rounded card with intro paragraph, dark hatched metric cards, and an outline pill button

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-13
items.description: [Shadcnship] A how-it-works section with a 3-card carousel, progress tab bar, and active step details

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-14
items.description: [Shadcnship] A how-it-works section with centered header and a 2-column grid of image cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-15
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered feature section with badge, phone mockup on a dot pattern background, and highlighted description

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-16
items.description: [Shadcnship] A two-column feature section with labels, titles, learn-more links, and visual cards below

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-17
items.description: [Shadcnship] An alternating 2-column feature grid with thin borders, text and illustration cells, and category tags

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-18
items.description: [Shadcnship] A dark case-studies section with gradient title, white cards with category labels and plus buttons, and a view-all link

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A testimonial gallery with a dominant featured landscape card and three narrow portrait brand cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/contact-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] A pro contact form with split layout, tour select, image slot, and contact info strip

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-19
items.description: [Shadcnship] An editorial split section with large title, two compared image panels, circular arrow button, and footer bar

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-20
items.description: [Shadcnship] A 3-card feature section with decorative UI mockups (form, call, pricing) and split header

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card that flips in 3D on hover to reveal features and a call to action, built with React and Tailwind CSS transforms and transitions.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Bottom drawer with spring-based slide-in and staggered content reveal, built on Vaul with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Hero section with translucent geometric shapes that drop in and float over a gradient backdrop. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI thinking indicator that cycles status messages with a shimmering gradient text effect. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated shimmer text with a looping gradient sweep across the letters, built with React, Tailwind CSS gradients and Motion animations.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Horizontally scrolling card carousel with ratings, badges and arrow navigation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui primitives.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Drag and drop file upload with animated progress, file validation and error states. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Search bar with debounced input, shortcut hints, and an animated action suggestions dropdown, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] AI search chat input with toggleable web search mode, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Multi-step currency exchange card with animated progress and SVG checkmark confirmation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/background-paths
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of flowing SVG line paths drawn across the hero section. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion path animations.

items.name: kokonutui/mouse-effect-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card with an animated dot pattern that repels away from the cursor, powered by React, Tailwind CSS and Motion spring physics.

items.name: kokonutui/beams-background
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of drifting light beams rendered on an HTML canvas with configurable intensity. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/flow-field
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Canvas particle flow field background with noise-driven streams of glowing light, color themes and density options. Built with React and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/apple-activity-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated activity rings card inspired by the Apple Fitness app, with progress circles built in React using Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-voice
items.description: [kokonut/ui] AI voice input button with recording timer, pulsing waveform bars and listening state. Built with React and animated Tailwind CSS styles.

items.name: kokonutui/smooth-tab
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated tab switcher with a sliding active indicator and smooth card content transitions, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/team-selector
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated team size selector with stacked overlapping avatars, spring transitions and increment controls. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/switch-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Light and dark theme toggle button with a rotating sun icon and shimmer hover effect, built with React, next-themes, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/bento-grid
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Responsive bento grid of feature cards with animated charts, counters and timelines, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/social-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Share button that expands into a row of social icon buttons with staggered Motion animations on hover, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/hold-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Press-and-hold confirmation button with an animated progress fill, configurable hold duration, and color variants, built with React and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/attract-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Magnetic button that pulls floating particles to its center on hover using Motion spring animations, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/gradient-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, soft inner glow, and hover overlay, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Figma-inspired toolbar where the selected tool expands to reveal its label with spring animations, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI loading state cycling task statuses through a scrolling code-style log with an SVG progress spinner. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Stack of product cards that expands on click to reveal details and specs, animated with Motion and styled with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated avatar picker with SVG avatar options, colored selection ring and username input. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/type-writer
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Typewriter text animation that types and deletes multiple sequences with a blinking cursor and auto loop, built with React and Motion.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Hover text effect with layered colorful shadows that snap flat on mouseover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion hover animations.

items.name: kokonutui/sliced-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Text effect that splits into two offset slices and merges together on hover using clip-path, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/glitch-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Customizable glitch text effect with adjustable intensity, colors and sizes, animated in React with Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/matrix-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Matrix-style text effect where letters scramble through binary characters before revealing, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/dynamic-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated text switcher that cycles through greetings in multiple languages, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion enter and exit transitions.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Button that bursts animated particles from its center on click with a quick scale press effect, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/tweet-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] X (Twitter) style post card with author details, verified badge, reply thread and hover gradient, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Scroll-driven text list that highlights the active word as you scroll, using IntersectionObserver with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Apple-inspired liquid glass card and buttons using SVG displacement filters for a refractive effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] User profile dropdown menu with avatar, subscription and model details, and quick action links, built with React, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS.

items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/slide-text-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/morphic-navbar
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Navigation bar whose active link morphs into a rounded pill with smooth CSS transitions, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/spotlight-cards
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Feature card grid with ambient aurora glow, magnetic 3D tilt and focus dimming on hover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion springs.

items.name: hextaui/theme
items.description: [HextaUI] HextaUI design tokens: status colors, easing curves, hairline borders, type scale and the keyframes every component animates with.

items.name: hextaui/hotkey
items.description: [HextaUI] Parse, label, announce and match keyboard shortcuts, with ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl everywhere else.

items.name: hextaui/motion
items.description: [HextaUI] The easing curves, durations and reduced-motion check every component animates with, plus hooks for size morphs and sliding highlights.

items.name: hextaui/use-autosize
items.description: [HextaUI] Grows a textarea with what you write between its minimum and maximum height, animating each change without ever touching the text.

items.name: hextaui/use-button-feedback
items.description: [HextaUI] Runs an async action through loading, success and error, skipping the spinner for fast requests and holding an error while you read it.

items.name: hextaui/use-composed-ref
items.description: [HextaUI] Keeps a ref to your own element while still forwarding it to whatever ref the parent passed in.

items.name: hextaui/use-delayed-loading
items.description: [HextaUI] Shows a loading state only when work is actually slow, then keeps it up long enough that it never flickers.

items.name: hextaui/use-held-keys
items.description: [HextaUI] The keys someone is holding down right now, shared by every subscriber through a single set of window listeners.

items.name: hextaui/use-invalid-shake
items.description: [HextaUI] Shakes a form control when a submit attempt finds it invalid, and never while someone is still typing.

items.name: hextaui/use-merged-ref
items.description: [HextaUI] Combines any number of callback and object refs into one, with React 19 ref cleanup for each of them.

items.name: hextaui/use-pagination
items.description: [HextaUI] Turns a page and a page count into the list of pages and ellipses to render, keeping its length steady as the page moves.

items.name: hextaui/use-today
items.description: [HextaUI] Today's date that rolls over at midnight and when the tab comes back, without a hydration mismatch.

items.name: hextaui/accordion
items.description: [HextaUI] Stacked headings that each reveal a panel, with height motion you can reverse mid-way and panels that stay searchable while closed.

items.name: hextaui/alert
items.description: [HextaUI] Inline messages for status and feedback, with a neutral surface, a colored icon and a dismiss that collapses smoothly.

items.name: hextaui/alert-dialog
items.description: [HextaUI] A confirmation dialog for destructive or important actions that waits for async work, and becomes a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: hextaui/aspect-ratio
items.description: [HextaUI] A box that holds its shape before media loads, shimmers while loading, fades the media in and falls back when it fails.

items.name: hextaui/attachment
items.description: [HextaUI] File and image cards for uploads, with progress, states, actions, a full-card trigger and names that keep their extension.

items.name: hextaui/avatar
items.description: [HextaUI] User photos with an initials fallback, status badges and stacked groups that collapse into a count.

items.name: hextaui/badge
items.description: [HextaUI] Status labels with colored dots, removable tags that slide closed and counts that roll to their new value.

items.name: hextaui/breadcrumb
items.description: [HextaUI] A trail of links to the current page that wraps safely, mirrors in right-to-left layouts and expands collapsed segments in place.

items.name: hextaui/bubble
items.description: [HextaUI] Chat message bubbles with variants, grouped corners, reactions and room for interactive content.

items.name: hextaui/button
items.description: [HextaUI] Buttons in every variant and size, with a built-in loading, success and error flow that skips the spinner for fast requests.

items.name: hextaui/button-group
items.description: [HextaUI] Buttons joined into one control, with shared seams, separators, text addons, nesting and vertical stacks.

items.name: hextaui/calendar
items.description: [HextaUI] A date grid for single, range and multiple selection, with sliding months, range previews and touch-sized days.

items.name: hextaui/card
items.description: [HextaUI] A surface for grouping content, with three variants, edge-to-edge media, concentric radii and whole-card links.

items.name: hextaui/carousel
items.description: [HextaUI] Native scroll-snap slides with momentum on touch, mouse dragging, arrow keys, dots, thumbnails and an autoplay that pauses when it should.

items.name: hextaui/chart
items.description: [HextaUI] Recharts charts with themed colors, a tooltip and legend that read labels from one config, and keyboard navigation with a visible focus ring.

items.name: hextaui/checkbox
items.description: [HextaUI] A checkbox whose check draws in, with indeterminate parents, groups and labels that share its hover.

items.name: hextaui/collapsible
items.description: [HextaUI] A panel that shows and hides with height motion you can reverse mid-way, without jumping the layout.

items.name: hextaui/combobox
items.description: [HextaUI] A filterable select with chips, groups and async results, in a popup that resizes as you type.

items.name: hextaui/command
items.description: [HextaUI] A searchable list of actions, inline or as a ⌘K palette, with pages, shortcuts and highlighted matches.

items.name: hextaui/context-menu
items.description: [HextaUI] A menu of actions on right click or long press, with submenus, checkbox and radio items, and hold feedback on touch.

items.name: hextaui/data-table
items.description: [HextaUI] A table for real data, with sorting, search, row selection, pinned columns, a sticky header and pagination.

items.name: hextaui/date-picker
items.description: [HextaUI] A button that opens a calendar in a popover, or a bottom sheet on phones, for single dates and ranges.

items.name: hextaui/dialog
items.description: [HextaUI] A window over the page for forms and focused tasks, with a pinned header and footer, nesting, and a swipeable bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: hextaui/drawer
items.description: [HextaUI] A panel that slides in from any edge and follows your finger, with snap points, a working handle and nested drawers that stack.

items.name: hextaui/dropdown-menu
items.description: [HextaUI] A menu of actions and options behind a button, with groups, submenus, checkbox and radio items, and shortcuts.

items.name: hextaui/empty
items.description: [HextaUI] A placeholder for screens with nothing to show yet, with an icon, a message and the next action.

items.name: hextaui/field
items.description: [HextaUI] Labels, descriptions and errors wired to their control, with validation states and layouts for forms.

items.name: hextaui/hover-card
items.description: [HextaUI] A preview card that opens when a link is hovered or focused, for content sighted users can glance at.

items.name: hextaui/input
items.description: [HextaUI] A text input with three sizes, invalid and read-only states, native validation styling and a 16px touch font so phones never zoom in.

items.name: hextaui/input-group
items.description: [HextaUI] An input with icons, text, buttons or a keyboard hint attached, sharing one border and focus ring.

items.name: hextaui/input-otp
items.description: [HextaUI] One-time code slots that take typing, paste and SMS autofill, with an opt-in animation that cascades codes in and a status for verifying.

items.name: hextaui/item
items.description: [HextaUI] A row of media, text and actions for lists, settings and pickers, with a grouped surface and a hover highlight that glides between rows.

items.name: hextaui/kbd
items.description: [HextaUI] Key caps for shortcuts that show the right symbols on every platform, read them out properly and press down with the real keys.

items.name: hextaui/label
items.description: [HextaUI] A label that follows its control, dimming when it's disabled and marking it required or optional on its own.

items.name: hextaui/marker
items.description: [HextaUI] Quiet notes between content, like date dividers and system events, with sticky dates and times that read as Today or Yesterday.

items.name: hextaui/menubar
items.description: [HextaUI] A desktop-style bar of menus with one highlight that slides between open menus and instant switching as you sweep across.

items.name: hextaui/message
items.description: [HextaUI] A chat message row with an avatar, name, bubbles and status, where new messages rise in from the sender's side.

items.name: hextaui/message-scroller
items.description: [HextaUI] A chat scroll area that follows new messages, keeps your place while you read back, and counts what you missed on the jump button.

items.name: hextaui/native-select
items.description: [HextaUI] The browser's own select, styled to match Input, with a quiet placeholder, Field support and the OS picker on every device.

items.name: hextaui/navigation-menu
items.description: [HextaUI] Site navigation with dropdowns, or one full-width panel that stays open while its content slides between menus.

items.name: hextaui/number-flow
items.description: [HextaUI] Animated numbers where only the changed digits spin, with any Intl format and locale.

items.name: hextaui/pagination
items.description: [HextaUI] Page navigation that keeps every button in place, glides to the current page and jumps to any page from the ellipsis.

items.name: hextaui/popover
items.description: [HextaUI] A floating panel anchored to a trigger that resizes smoothly with its content and follows the trigger’s direction.

items.name: hextaui/progress
items.description: [HextaUI] A bar or ring that shows how far a task has come, eases between updates and slides while the total is unknown.

items.name: hextaui/questionnaire
items.description: [HextaUI] A step-by-step form that moves between questions with a sense of direction, shows real progress and answers from the keyboard.

items.name: hextaui/radio-group
items.description: [HextaUI] Pick one option from a set, with a dot that hands off between choices and cards whose selection ring slides to the new pick.

items.name: hextaui/resizable
items.description: [HextaUI] Panels you can drag apart, with a quiet divider that wakes up on hover, sizes that glide on reset or collapse, and layouts that persist.

items.name: hextaui/safe-area
items.description: [HextaUI] A pointer safe triangle that keeps submenus and flyouts open while the cursor travels diagonally toward them.

items.name: hextaui/scroll-area
items.description: [HextaUI] Native scrolling with a minimal scrollbar, edges that fade only where there’s more to see, and an optional peek that cuts the last item in half.

items.name: hextaui/select
items.description: [HextaUI] Pick one or more options from a list that opens on the current value, with typeahead, groups and form support.

items.name: hextaui/separator
items.description: [HextaUI] A hairline that divides content horizontally or vertically, with an optional label and a decorative mode for purely visual lines.

items.name: hextaui/sheet
items.description: [HextaUI] A panel that slides in from any edge, with swipe-to-dismiss, scroll lock and stacked nesting.

items.name: hextaui/sidebar
items.description: [HextaUI] An app sidebar that collapses to icons or off canvas, stays pinned under your header, and becomes a swipeable sheet on phones.

items.name: hextaui/skeleton
items.description: [HextaUI] Placeholders that wait 150ms before showing, take the exact size of the content they wrap, and fade it in without moving anything.

items.name: hextaui/slider
items.description: [HextaUI] Pick a value or a range by dragging, tapping the track or using the keys, with jumps that glide and an optional value bubble.

items.name: hextaui/spinner
items.description: [HextaUI] A loading indicator with Apple-style ticks or a breathing ring that can wait before showing and stay long enough not to flicker.

items.name: hextaui/switch
items.description: [HextaUI] An on/off toggle you can tap, press or drag, with a thumb that stretches under your finger and an optional pending state for saves.

items.name: hextaui/table
items.description: [HextaUI] A responsive table with a surface style, wrapping or compact cells, sticky headers, pinned columns and scroll hints.

items.name: hextaui/tabs
items.description: [HextaUI] Switch between views with an indicator that slides to the active tab, as a segmented control or an underline, and lists that scroll when they overflow.

items.name: hextaui/textarea
items.description: [HextaUI] Multi-line text that grows smoothly with what you write between a minimum and maximum number of rows, with counters, validation and a submit shortcut.

items.name: hextaui/toast
items.description: [HextaUI] Brief messages that stack neatly, expand on hover, swipe away, and turn a loading state into success or error in place.

items.name: hextaui/toggle
items.description: [HextaUI] A button that stays on or off, with a fill that settles in when pressed, a clear hover-to-on step and icons that can fill with the state.

items.name: hextaui/toggle-group
items.description: [HextaUI] A row of toggles for one choice or many, with a fill that slides to the picked item, joined or spaced items and arrow-key focus.

items.name: hextaui/tooltip
items.description: [HextaUI] A short hint on hover or keyboard focus that opens after a brief rest, switches instantly between neighbours and shows shortcuts.

items.name: hextaui/tree
items.description: [HextaUI] Nested, expandable rows for files and hierarchies, with indent guides, connector lines, cascading checkboxes, typeahead and full keyboard support.

items.name: hextaui/video-player
items.description: [HextaUI] A video player with a scrubbable seek bar, auto-hiding controls, keyboard shortcuts, speed, picture in picture and full screen.

items.name: hextaui/all
items.description: [HextaUI] Every HextaUI component, the theme, shared libs and hooks in one install.

items.name: assistant-ui/utils

items.description: [Trophy UI] React streak counter UI in a compact badge supporting daily, weekly, monthly or yearly streaks. Built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Open source.

items.description: [Trophy UI] React streak calendar for gamification—week, month, and git-style grids to visualize consistency. Native support for streak freezes. Ideal streak UI design for habit tracking and personal progress. Built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. Open source.

items.name: trophy-ui/achievement-list
items.description: [Trophy UI] Vertical React achievement list with icons, descriptions, and optional progress for dense achievement UI. Complements grids and cards in gamification dashboards. Open source, built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind.

items.name: trophy-ui/achievement-unlocked
items.description: [Trophy UI] Celebratory React dialog for newly unlocked achievements with headline, badge, and share actions. Use for unlock moments, level up animations and more. Built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Open source.

items.name: zyeon/metaball-blobs
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A gooey organic background — token-tinted blobs drift on seeded Lissajous orbits and fuse into one body through an SVG alpha-threshold filter, optionally leaning toward the pointer.

items.name: zyeon/warp-tunnel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A hyperspace speed tunnel on one canvas — seeded, tapered streaks leave a movable vanishing point and accelerate outward with perspective foreshortening.

items.name: zyeon/progressive-blur
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A gradual-blur edge treatment — stacked backdrop-filter layers with geometrically growing radii, each masked to its own slice of the band, so content melts into frosted glass toward one edge instead of hitting a hard blur line.

items.name: zyeon/kinetic-headline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A fixed headline with one rotating word slot whose width springs to each incoming word, so the rest of the line glides instead of jumping.

items.name: zyeon/variable-font-scroll
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A headline whose variable-font axes interpolate with scroll position, thickening character by character as it crosses the viewport and falling back to a static weight on non-variable families.

items.name: zyeon/outline-fill-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Stroked outline type whose solid copy is wiped in by an animated clip-path inset — on scroll, on hover, or on mount.

items.name: zyeon/text-clip-media
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Display type whose glyphs become a window onto media — an image, a muted looping video or a token gradient fills the letters, leans away from the pointer, and degrades to a solid token whenever clipping is unsupported or the media never arrives.

items.name: zyeon/custom-cursor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A container-scoped pointer replacement: a spring-driven dot that follows the hand and opens into a difference-blended disc over interactive targets, hiding the native arrow only while the pointer is inside and never drawing on coarse pointers or under reduced motion.

items.name: zyeon/cursor-trail
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A canvas pointer wake that samples the cursor once per animation frame and draws it as a tapering ribbon, an evenly spaced bead chain or drifting sparks, each node dissolving on its own lifetime.

items.name: zyeon/glow-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A card whose surface and border light up around the pointer, with an optional group where the hovered card stays lit and its siblings dim.

items.name: zyeon/holo-foil-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A card surface that behaves like trading-card holo stock — an iridescent gradient sheet, a fine foil grating and a specular highlight all re-aimed from the pointer, with an optional tilt.

items.name: zyeon/elastic-drag-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A card you can grab and fling — it chases the pointer on a spring, tilts with its own drag velocity, and springs home or docks into a snap point on release.

items.name: zyeon/magnetic-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A lattice of tiles that leans toward — or away from — the cursor, resolved for every tile from a single pointer listener with distance falloff.

items.name: zyeon/canvas-reveal-hover
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A panel that reveals a seeded dot matrix on a canvas beneath its content — squares ignite outward from where the pointer or focus entered, and dissolve in a scattered order when it leaves.

items.name: zyeon/split-screen-hover
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Full-height panels that share one row and rebalance around the pointer — the hovered or focused panel takes the width and opens its copy while the others compress, dim and desaturate.

items.name: zyeon/parallax-layers
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A depth wrapper — each child declares a depth and translates at that proportional rate as the container passes through the scrollport, with an optional pointer nudge, driven by one rAF-throttled listener and zero re-renders.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-velocity-skew
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A wrapper that leans and slightly scales its content in proportion to scroll velocity, then eases back to neutral the moment scrolling stops.

items.name: zyeon/video-scrub-scroll
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A video whose playhead is driven by scroll position — a pinned section maps its scroll window onto currentTime with rAF-coalesced, readyState-guarded seeks, and falls back to the poster plus an ordinary play control under reduced motion, an unseekable source or a load error.

items.name: zyeon/liquid-distortion-image
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A picture that ripples where the pointer touches it — an SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap twin over the untouched original, masked to a soft lens that follows the cursor and settles back when it leaves.

items.name: zyeon/image-accordion
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A row of tall image slices where the open panel widens to reveal its caption and link while the rest compress to labelled slivers, folding into a vertical stack on narrow screens.

items.name: zyeon/coverflow-carousel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A 3D perspective carousel whose covers sit on an arc — the centre faces the viewer while neighbours rotate away into depth with dimming and an optional masked reflection — driven by one continuous position that drag, horizontal wheel and arrow keys all share, with a plain scroll-snap fallback under

items.name: zyeon/pin-gallery
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A section that pins while its gallery travels sideways — vertical scroll drives a horizontal track of cards, with a progress rail, per-item snap points and a plain scroll-snap scroller when motion is off.

items.name: zyeon/logo-morph
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One SVG shape that morphs between several logo or icon paths on a timer, on hover or from a controlled index, normalising the paths at runtime so their points pair up and cross-fading when they cannot.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/button-glass
items.description: [ns-ui] Liquid-glass button with translucent blurred surface and press states.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/button-retry-backoff
items.description: [ns-ui] A retry button that visibly winds a torsion spring through its backoff: disabled and charging while a --foreground arc grows on real timing, notching every failure, pressable only once fully wound.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/cambium-lay
items.description: [ns-ui] A tree cross-section accreting live in SVG: a cambium ring lays wood outward year by year, each year closing with a thin dense latewood band, the section slightly lobed and drifting off-centre like a leaning trunk, and a scar event pinching a few rings before growth heals around it.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/capstan-slip
items.description: [ns-ui] A determinate progress bar redrawn as an analog tape transport: a capstan shaft turns at a strictly constant rate while a pinch roller's nip actually sets the tape's speed, and every ~1.1s the nip visibly compresses, slips, and springs back through one small overshoot.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/carbon-ply-fade
items.description: [ns-ui] Activity feed rendered as a carbon-paper multi-part form: one strike lands on the top ply at full density and echoes down through 4-5 contiguous, fully-visible ply rows, each registering 90ms after the one above at 0.68x the density, matching real pressure-copy force dissipation through a stack.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/card-dot-gain-screen
items.description: [ns-ui] A card backed by a contact-screen halftone that reproduces real dot gain: a nonlinear per-dot growth curve where the deepest tones grow past the point of staying separate circles and physically bridge into plugged solid ink.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/card-number-emboss
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-number input rendered as an embossing machine: typed digits raise as bevel-shadowed metal, a stamping-head caret dips on every keystroke, and a brand watermark fades in once enough digits exist.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/carousel-card-riffle
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-stack navigator that shows its actual card edges as a scrubbable stripe of thin lines: dragging it riffles cards past with quick flip-past kicks, and the same stripe doubles as the pagination readout.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/catenary-contact-stagger
items.description: [ns-ui] A live connection/sync-quality indicator built from overhead contact wire stagger: a fixed pantograph marker tracks the wire's deliberate zigzag span by span, and only arcs, briefly, on the rare span where contact genuinely breaks.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/cathode-stack-glow
items.description: [ns-ui] A Nixie-tube stat readout: ten wire-mesh cathode digits stacked behind a shared anode mesh, the struck digit glowing over faint ghost outlines of the nine behind it, with a periodic silent conditioning sweep through all ten to keep unused cathodes from fouling.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chain-scale
items.description: [ns-ui] A map zoom control that is the scale bar: drag its end handle in log space to zoom, and the bar's length always reads a sayable 1-2-5 round distance, snapping with a 180ms width spring at every ladder crossing instead of drawing an arbitrary raw number.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-bar-halftone
items.description: [ns-ui] Bar chart whose fills are an ordered-dither halftone instead of a flat color: ink density tracks value as a second, redundant channel to height.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-donut-halftone
items.description: [ns-ui] Donut chart for an ordinal size scale where wedge angle carries share and ordered-dither density carries tier order, instead of a second colour.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-funnel-stage-drop
items.description: [ns-ui] Canvas funnel chart in ordered-dither ink density, where hovering or focusing a stage animates its own drop-off as ink particles falling into the next stage.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-line-dither
items.description: [ns-ui] Canvas line/area chart in ordered-dither ink density, where a scrub cursor drags a local higher-resolution loupe through the fill as it moves.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-radar-dither
items.description: [ns-ui] Canvas radar/spider chart in ordered-dither ink density, swept by a continuously rotating radar line that locally resolves each axis wedge to sharper ink as it passes.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-ridgeline-terrain
items.description: [ns-ui] Unknown-Pleasures ridgeline chart whose live history recedes into scrolling ambient noise terrain, dented gravitationally by the cursor.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-scatter-ascii-bin
items.description: [ns-ui] Two-dimensional scatter plot rendered as a glyph-density grid, with a pointer- or keyboard-driven brush that live re-bins the exact points under it and reads out the selection.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/chart-waterfall-ascii-step
items.description: [ns-ui] ASCII-ramp waterfall chart where toggling a step excludes or restores its delta and every bar after it (plus the running total) visibly recomputes and re-animates, not just a hover tooltip.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/checkbox-domino-run
items.description: [ns-ui] Select-all where the change propagates like a domino run: flip the master and a wavefront tips down the list, each row's checkbox flipping and shoving the next. Click any row mid-run to halt the wave there, leaving the rest untouched.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/checkbox-ink-stroke
items.description: [ns-ui] A checkbox and its tri-state select-all cousin whose mark is inked on by a variable-width calligraphic pen stroke (thin entry, thick corner flick, a hair of overshoot at the tip), so checked, unchecked and indeterminate read as three distinct pen gestures.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/checkbox-tally-notch
items.description: [ns-ui] Checkbox group rendered as a carpenter's tally: each check carves a notch stroke into its row and adds a stroke to an aggregate tally cluster in the header, where every fifth stroke slashes diagonally across its group of four. Strokes draw on with a dashoffset sweep and retract on uncheck.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/compare-crack-seam

items.name: nikolas-sapa/confidence-logprob-hatch

items.description: [ns-ui] File upload where progress is the container: a loose dashed outline 24px outside the card pulls taut as the file uploads, clicks shut with a pucker at 100%, and relaxes back out with a wobble on failure.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/file-upload-thermal
items.description: [ns-ui] File dropzone as a thermal field: dragging spawns rising accent convection wisps, accepted drops buoy off the drop point and squash-land into a docked queue rack, rejected files sink and fade.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/filter-facet-mesh
items.description: [ns-ui] Faceted filter chips as a sieve: active facets read as taut, bright threads in a hairline mesh fanned from a hub above the chip row, hovering a chip visibly tightens its own thread, and deselecting one opens a gap that shakes a few result particles through as the count sifts to its new value.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/flamegraph-ascii-frames
items.description: [ns-ui] A CPU-profile flame graph laid out in monospace cells (one row per stack depth, frame width proportional to sample count, self-vs-total time encoded as ink weight), where clicking a frame rezooms the whole graph to that subtree.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/flash-entrain
items.description: [ns-ui] A few hundred DOM fireflies pulse-couple over a static nearest-neighbour graph (Mirollo-Strogatz), so the field self-organises from scattered twinkle through travelling bands into unison and a handful of deaf individuals pull it apart again, forever, with no scripted reset.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/float-ribbon-draw
items.description: [ns-ui] A multi-stage pipeline/job-status bar modeled on the float-glass process: a fixed molten-to-set thermal gradient marks the pipeline's stages while a faint ripple scrolls continuously through the still-molten zone at a constant draw speed, so the bar keeps reading as 'actively running' whether or not

items.name: nikolas-sapa/floret-pack
items.description: [ns-ui] A full-bleed phyllotactic hero background where primordia are birthed one at a time at a central meristem, golden-angle sequenced and locally relaxed as they advect outward, so the 34/55 parastichy spirals emerge from genuine growth rather than a closed-form layout.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/flyball-throttle
items.description: [ns-ui] A spend-cap widget drawn as a Watt centrifugal governor: two hinged arms with ball weights fly wider as burn rate outpaces the sustainable rate, the sleeve collar they drive slides down the spindle, and the collar's own linkage swings a throttle lever closed over the purchase actions. items.name: nikolas-sapa/footer-ascii-rule
items.description: [ns-ui] A sitemap footer whose back-to-top control is a real instrument: an aria-hidden vertical rail beside it continuously reads actual scroll position, and the button drives a real spring back to the top rather than a jump. Grabbing the wheel mid-flight yields it immediately.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/frank-register
items.description: [ns-ui] Paying from a prepaid wallet rendered as a postal franking meter: committing stamps an indicium onto the invoice while a descending BALANCE odometer rolls down and an ascending SPENT odometer rolls up by the same amount, the two always summing to credits purchased.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/frazil-dam

items.name: nikolas-sapa/fugitive-ink
items.description: [ns-ui] A one-time secret panel that prints a new API key or recovery code fully legible, then lets it fade like security ink, armed by the user's own copy or by clicking away, never by a modal you close and lose.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/fusee-cone
items.description: [ns-ui] A burn-rate alert policy editor built as a clock fusee: error budget is the mainspring barrel, a chain rides down a tapering cone as budget depletes, and alert sensitivity at any budget level is the cone's local radius, authored by dragging exactly 4 monotone control points, with a real multi-window

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gallery-ascii-gradient-orientation
items.description: [ns-ui] A gallery grid where each tile runs its own procedural 3-octave value-noise field and a 3x3 Sobel operator selects glyphs by the field's own gradient ANGLE, bucketed into '-', '/', '|', '\\', keeping only the adaptively top-12%-by-magnitude cells each frame so the field reads as a moving edge sketch

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gallery-coverflow-caustic
items.description: [ns-ui] 3D coverflow gallery whose frosted-glass cards run a live caustic-light simulation: drifting light pools refract across each pane, and drag velocity fringes the focused card's edges with chromatic aberration that settles to zero at rest.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/galley-bracket
items.description: [ns-ui] Remote collaborators' live selections drawn as proofreader's marks: thin corner brackets at each end of a range and a hairline underline, nesting outward by arrival order where ranges overlap, instead of overlapping tinted highlight fills.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gantt-ascii-critical-path
items.description: [ns-ui] An ASCII Gantt chart where a real CPM forward/backward pass decides which bars are critical: zero-float tasks draw heavy `━` in accent, the rest light `─`, and dragging a task re-runs the pass so the critical chain moves.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gather-marver
items.description: [ns-ui] A file-upload / processing indicator sourced from the real hot-glass gather-and-marver sequence: an off-centre blob rolls back and forth on a flat baseline, losing its lumps a little more with every roll pass while it spins continuously underneath, the correction visibly progressing rather than a ge

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gauge-capacity-waterline
items.description: [ns-ui] Capacity-vs-legal-limit meter drawn as a ship's side-profile hull with Plimsoll load-line marks: the waterline rises with load, the hull itself settles a few px deeper on a separate spring, and the S mark flips to amber the moment load passes the legal limit.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/git-graph-ascii-lanes
items.description: [ns-ui] A commit-history DAG rendered as `git log --graph` does, where a real lane-allocation pass assigns each branch a column and emits `│ ├─┐ ┘ ┼` connector rows, and hovering a commit lights its full ancestor set through the lanes.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/glaze-crawl-heal
items.description: [ns-ui] A live status badge drawn as a glaze surface mid-firing: gas bubbles burst through the molten glaze and the melt either flows back over the crater (heals) or, when surface tension has failed, pulls away into a ragged bare patch that never closes (crawling). Three real ceramics behaviours standing in

items.name: nikolas-sapa/glory-hole-cycle
items.description: [ns-ui] A 'still actively processing' status chip whose small canvas glow rises fast and cools slow on a fixed 4.0s beat, modeled on a glassblower's furnace reheat cycle instead of a generic pulsing dot.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gluten-windowpane
items.description: [ns-ui] A background-task progress indicator built on the baker's windowpane test: a dough membrane is stretched, held, and released on a repeating 4-cycle knead loop, going from opaque and jittery-stranded to translucent, straight-stranded and light-through as kneading 'develops', then rests fully develope

items.name: nikolas-sapa/gravure-cell-wipe
items.description: [ns-ui] A divider / background texture strip printed as a rotogravure cylinder: a static, seeded matrix of engraved cell depths sits under a doctor-blade band that sweeps and wraps every 20s, wiping the flooded land clean and leaving each cell's ink alpha at its depth-derived steady state, with a decaying b

items.name: nikolas-sapa/grazing-light
items.description: [ns-ui] A feature-grid card whose icon and heading are blind-embossed into the surface: invisible relief that a low-angle light reveals as it rakes slowly across at idle, and that snaps to track the pointer's bearing across the whole grid at once.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/grid-bento-ascii
items.description: [ns-ui] A 2x2 bento layout primitive built on its own content/seam track grid (a real vertical rule, horizontal rule and ┼ junction between the four tiles), where activating a tile re-spans it across every track, seam included, so the junction has nowhere left to be drawn.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/grid-bento-dense
items.description: [ns-ui] A composable bento grid where activating a tile genuinely promotes it: the tile takes a 2x2 slot and every other tile re-packs around it via CSS grid-auto-flow: dense, FLIP-animated so the reflow reads as tiles sliding into new slots rather than jumping.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/grid-magnetic-lattice
items.description: [ns-ui] Card grid on a magnetized hairline lattice: the cursor bends the grid lines and the DOM cards sample the same displacement field, riding the bent sheet.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/grinding-chatter-lobes
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-scale loader substitute driven by regenerative chatter in cylindrical grinding: a rotating disc's rim grows a lobed profile as it re-cuts its own previous pass, the wave self-amplifying then self-limiting until a dress event clears it and a new lobe count begins.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/groove-pitch
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient loader modeling a vinyl mastering lathe's variable groove pitch: a cutting-point marker spirals outward from a lead-in, its own turn spacing visibly widening over loud passages and tightening over quiet ones, completing a side and resetting to lead-in on an unbounded loop.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/growth-ring
items.description: [ns-ui] Version history as a dendrochronological cross-section: one ring per save, ring width proportional to change size, a dark line wherever authorship changed hands, and restoring an older version previews the discard as outer rings hinging open before you confirm.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/guardrail-interlock-keys
items.description: [ns-ui] Output guardrails built as a trapped-key interlock: every policy gate holds one key, the release bolt only retracts when all of them are seated, and a tripped gate is a visibly empty, barred keyway rather than a red badge.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hachure-fall
items.description: [ns-ui] A route elevation profile drawn as 18th-century military engravers drew slope: strokes perpendicular to the profile line, hanging down the fall direction, whose length and density both derive from local grade. No colour ramp, no vertical-exaggeration slider.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/header-scroll-pill
items.description: [ns-ui] A page header that morphs between a full-width quiet nav bar at the top and a floating centered pill once scrolled: spring-like width/radius/padding morph, section label roll, and a progress hairline, with hysteresis so it never flutters at the threshold and a fast upward scroll flicks it back open

items.name: nikolas-sapa/heatmap-year-stipple
items.description: [ns-ui] A GitHub-style year activity calendar where intensity is stipple density, not color: every day cell holds a handful of deterministically jittered ink dots, denser for more activity, like an engraved print. items.name: nikolas-sapa/helicorder-line-wrap
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient status widget shaped like a seismograph helicorder drum: a pen traces one line at a time and steps down to a fresh line the instant it runs off the right margin, so the record grows as a stack of offset traces rather than one continuous scroll.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hero-ascii-wordmark
items.description: [ns-ui] Hero wordmark rendered as ASCII block-letters, lit by the pointer like a torch over a density ramp.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hero-dipole-field
items.description: [ns-ui] Full-bleed hero where the headline exists twice: crisp DOM type above, and beneath it a canvas field of iron-filing strokes solved from a two-pole dipole field, so the type visibly iron-files into existence as the cursor approaches and CTA hover bends the whole field toward the button.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hero-long-exposure
items.description: [ns-ui] Hero card whose canvas behaves like a long-exposure photograph: cursor movement burns light streaks that never clear per frame, only decay on a 4s half-life, accumulating a light painting of the session.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hero-particles-webgl
items.description: [ns-ui] Full-viewport hero with a cursor-reactive WebGL particle field and staggered text reveal.

items.description: [ns-ui] Live distribution instrument where the histogram IS the samples: each arrival falls as a grain into its bin and stacks, the heap visibly re-settles as the rolling window slides, and P50/P90 fences ride the same scale.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/honeycomb-draw

items.name: nikolas-sapa/hover-card-dwell
items.description: [ns-ui] A hover-card trigger that has to be wound before it opens: a hairline arc coils clockwise around a 5px dot while the pointer dwells, and drifting away mid-wind visibly unwinds it back instead of firing.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/idler-drop
items.description: [ns-ui] Delegated admin drawn as a gear train: your authority is the drive gear, each delegate is a driven gear whose tooth count sets a discrete role ratio, and revoking swings the idler out so their gear freewheels to a stop while yours keeps turning.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/image-crop-mat
items.description: [ns-ui] Image cropping as a passe-partout: four mat boards slide over a photo to define the crop window, snap to ratio presets with a settle, and show a rule-of-thirds grid only while dragging.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/index-contour
items.description: [ns-ui] A travel-time reach editor: one slider handle sets minutes, and the reach renders as topographic-style contour bands re-thresholded from a real per-node cost field via marching squares, with every third line heavier and labelled inline in a break in its own stroke.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/input-focus-membrane
items.description: [ns-ui] Text input whose focus ring is a living membrane: a noise-displaced canvas loop that breathes on idle, dilates on focus, sends a peristaltic pulse from the caret on each keystroke, constricts and quivers on error, and exhales once on valid submit.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/jacquard-card-chain
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient status strip modelled on a Jacquard loom's control mechanism: a chain of punched cards feeds past a fixed needle bank, one card read every beat, the bank rippling to the new pattern and holding before the next card slides in, looping forever.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/jam-kickout-loop
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient background-job status line built as bulk-mail sortation conveyor jam handling: most tiles ride the main line straight through, but a fixed 1-in-6 tile is diverted by a swinging arm onto a lower side loop and re-merged one cycle later for a second attempt, never stopping the line to clear

items.description: [ns-ui] A real site nav whose active-item indicator is a point source drifting along the link row, trailing a genuine Kelvin ship wake: a V-shaped envelope of transverse and diverging waves held at deep water's constant 19.47° half-angle regardless of how fast the source is currently moving.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/keymap-ascii-heat
items.description: [ns-ui] An ASCII keyboard layout that accumulates real ink density per key as you type into it: each keystroke inks the key, heat decays on an exponential half-life, and the legend rescales to whichever key is currently hottest.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/knife-edge-rack-focus
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-scale loader substitute built on the Foucault knife-edge test: a knife edge racks through a mirror's focus, sweeping the aperture's shadow pattern from one side to a flat null and back, with four baked zonal errors crossing that null at their own moment.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/knit-ladder-run

items.name: nikolas-sapa/leaven-crest-fall
items.description: [ns-ui] A sourdough starter jar status indicator: the surface dome rises with a Poisson-nucleated bubble texture to a peak, then collapses as the bubble population thins in step with the falling height, fed and risen again on a repeating 12.6s cycle.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/lens-ascii-magnify
items.description: [ns-ui] A circular lens that resolves the text under it into a denser dot-matrix of ASCII glyphs: every character it passes over is redrawn as its own 5x7 grid of ramp characters, more glyphs per glyph rather than the same glyph bigger.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/lenticule-swing
items.description: [ns-ui] A hero H1 lockup printed twice behind vertical lenticular slats (the problem statement and the product promise coexisting at once) that shimmers between both at rest and snaps cleanly to the promise as it scrolls out of view.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/lining-wear
items.description: [ns-ui] A dunning card for past-due subscriptions where the clutch grip on 'active' is a friction lining that wears down: every failed charge slips the pad and permanently scores one lamination, and the plate disengages to 'paused' once the lining is spent.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/listbox-sticky-groups
items.description: [ns-ui] A grouped listbox for long lists (timezones, countries, currencies) where every passed group header sticks in place, stacking into overlapping 20px slivers you can still read and click. A live table of contents made from the headers themselves.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-ascii-diffuse-fill
items.description: [ns-ui] Indeterminate ASCII loader whose texture comes from real Floyd-Steinberg serpentine error diffusion, propagated cell-to-cell every frame, rather than a fixed ordered-dither threshold matrix.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-braille
items.description: [ns-ui] Determinate/indeterminate loader built from braille dot patterns, where each cell's eight dots are individually addressable for far finer granularity than a block-character bar.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-die-tumble
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient loading glyph shaped as a die tumbling face over face on a fixed axle: each 90deg landing overshoots by 8deg and corrects on a spring, with a floor shadow compressing and flaring in sync, rather than rotating cleanly to a stop.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-ink-blob
items.description: [ns-ui] A small canvas-2D assistant-state indicator: a soft ink blob traced through 72 points around a circle, each perturbed by one of six distinct motion signatures (idle, thinking, listening, speaking, success, error), with a checkmark or X that strokes itself in for the two settled states.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-iris
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient loading glyph shaped as a six-blade camera-iris diaphragm breathing open and shut inside a fixed housing ring: one wedge shape repeated by rotation, its shared displacement keyframe overshooting each open and close before settling on a spring.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-pendulum-sync
items.description: [ns-ui] An indeterminate loader for long background work: a row of pendulums with slightly different periods drift from unison into apparent chaos and back into perfect sync on a knowable ~10s cycle, pure CSS with zero per-frame JS.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-spirograph-trace
items.description: [ns-ui] A determinate loader that traces a real hypotrochoid: the full closed rosette is always visible as a ghost, and progress is the fraction of that curve's arc length inked in, so 0% and 100% are both legible shapes rather than an empty ring.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-spring-bars
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient loading glyph shaped as a row of leaf springs on a rail: one displacement keyframe, staggered per bar by negative animation-delay, reads as a single pulse of energy travelling down the rack rather than bars animating in isolation.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/loader-thread-spool
items.description: [ns-ui] A loader that winds thread onto a spool while duration is unknown, then converts the same coil in place into a proportional gauge the instant total size arrives. The indeterminate-to-determinate handoff as one continuous object, never a spinner swapped for a bar.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/log-viewer-ascii-tail
items.description: [ns-ui] A live `tail -f` log pane with a real ring buffer, a per-line severity glyph column, and follow-mode that detaches the instant you scroll up and reports how many lines arrived while you were reading.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/logo-cloud-settle
items.description: [ns-ui] A trust-wall grid of abstract, generated marks that physically settles into place: each tile drops in from lifted/shrunk/tilted with a per-item stagger and a slight spring overshoot, triggered on viewport entry and replayed if the wall leaves and re-enters view.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/lug-cage-tally
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient loading glyph shaped as five pin wheels spinning at mutually-prime rates past a fixed read mark, each engaged pin brightening in a brief flash and nudging a 24-notch tally bar forward one segment, the bar rolling its window open-ended rather than ever resetting to empty.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/manifold-bleed
items.description: [ns-ui] A connected app's standing grants drawn as a valve manifold: each scope is a gate valve on a supply line from your account to the app, and revoking it drains the line backward toward you only after the server confirms, leaving a hairline ghost of what was once granted.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/map-choropleth-ascii
items.description: [ns-ui] ASCII-density choropleth over a fully synthetic hand-seeded tessellation. Hovering or keying through a region isolates it and the legend rescales to a band around its value.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/marquee-ticker-glyph
items.description: [ns-ui] A grabbable ticker tape: drag to scrub through its content, release to fling it with momentum, and legibility itself is a function of speed. Fast motion blurs characters into noise glyphs, slowing down resolves them back into real text.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/masonry-ascii-settle
items.description: [ns-ui] A masonry gallery whose tiles render as live ASCII halftone and resolve from a coarse print to a fine one as they drop into their packed column slot, re-packing and re-dropping every tile when a resize crosses a column-count breakpoint.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/melt-pond-drain
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-scale ambient loader/empty-state panel modelling Arctic melt-pond drainage: a shallow top-view basin whose pool fills over ~9-11s, then drains rapidly through a crack that opens at a new rim location each cycle, leaving a shallow residual pool that refills and repeats.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/memory-ledger-decay
items.description: [ns-ui] Session memory that visibly patinates: each remembered fact steps its ink from --foreground toward --ns-muted the longer it goes unused, snaps back and underlines when the agent rehearses it, and is governed by real pin/evict controls.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/menu-nested-trays
items.description: [ns-ui] Nested menus as telescoping card-catalog trays: opening a submenu shunts the parent back and dims it instead of spawning a flyout, leaving a 12px clickable edge per ancestor as a live breadcrumb of depth.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/mesh-lash
items.description: [ns-ui] A currency amount field where two meshed gears are the FX quote itself: tooth ratio draws the exchange rate, and mechanical backlash (the dead angle a reversed gear turns through before the other flank engages) is the provider's spread, printed as a currency figure straight off the gear math.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/meter-context-window
items.description: [ns-ui] A context-window budget meter: one hairline stacked bar segmenting the window into system prompt / tools / history / current turn, told apart by fill pattern instead of color, that visibly resettles rather than jumps when the window compacts.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/meter-latency-capillary
items.description: [ns-ui] Time-to-first-token rendered as calibrated capillary rise: a narrow tube climbs to a scribed p50 line, holds and trembles if it's running slow, and only surfaces retry/switch-model once it's genuinely past p95. Never fakes progress.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/meter-matrix-scan
items.description: [ns-ui] A level meter rendered as a genuinely row-multiplexed LED dot-matrix panel: five rows addressed round-robin off a real 240Hz-per-row clock, and each LED's brightness is a literal 8-step PWM duty-cycle quantization rather than a smooth analog fill. items.name: nikolas-sapa/meter-quota-meniscus

items.name: nikolas-sapa/meter-quota-rule

items.name: nikolas-sapa/minimap-pantograph

items.name: nikolas-sapa/mull-hinge
items.description: [ns-ui] A margin comment thread glued to its anchored phrase by a translucent tissue-strip hinge whose shear, opacity and tearing are a live readout of anchor health under concurrent edits.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/nav-blue-noise-scrim
items.description: [ns-ui] Dimming backdrop for a command palette or search overlay, dithered with a temporal blue-noise mask that reshuffles every frame instead of a flat tint.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/nav-condense-rail
items.description: [ns-ui] A full-width site nav that condenses in place as the page scrolls (roomy padding, full-size wordmark and links at the top, tightening to a dense pinned rail) over a distance measured from the bar's own rendered height at each extreme, not a guessed scroll-pixel constant.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/nav-overstrike-typewriter
items.description: [ns-ui] A real site nav with a typed ruled line beneath its links, shaded by striking two or three characters into the same cell (real typewriter overstrike compositing, not this registry's usual single-glyph density ramp), with the current page reading as the deepest stack.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/nav-site-condense
items.description: [ns-ui] A full-width site nav with the furniture a real site needs: a scroll-condensed bar, a menu trigger present at every width, and a mobile sheet built on native <dialog> for a free focus trap and Escape-to-close.
